facts.fact: 首次以国王身份过满月，借机办宴
facts.anchor: It was Winter’s first full moon as king, so he’d used the excuse to arrange a lavish gathering

facts.fact: 全是幌子：她不回来就当普通庆典
facts.anchor: Of course, it was all a ruse. If Sterling didn’t return to him tonight, then he could pretend this was nothing more than a celebration

facts.fact: 他不会再娶——就算她不回来
facts.anchor: He’d never take another. King Winter would remain a foolish sap in love

facts.fact: 他提醒自己：新王还没赢得全 pack 的敬意
facts.anchor: He was the king now—a new king who hadn’t earned the respect of the entire pack yet

facts.fact: 她掀开兜帽，绿眼在月光下如祖母绿
facts.anchor: she pulled back her hood and peered up at him with eager eyes that shone like emeralds beneath the moonlight

facts.fact: 她既是 RRH 也是他们的王后
facts.anchor: You are Red Riding Hood and their queen

facts.fact: 已按狼的传统结契，也该按人类婚礼成婚
facts.anchor: Since we mated in the tradition of wolves, I thought it was only fair we marry in a human wedding

facts.fact: 命定之人不一定也是狼
facts.anchor: Sometimes a shifter’s perfect match isn’t another wolf

facts.fact: 我以为自己没有爱的能力，可我爱你
facts.anchor: I didn’t think I could love anyone, that I was incapable of it, and yet I love you

facts.fact: 笼锁的钥匙被他重铸成婚戒
facts.anchor: I had the key to your cage reforged

facts.fact: 你永远自由、永不锁在我身上
facts.anchor: Know that you will always be free. Never chained to me. Even in marriage

facts.fact: 他的戒指里嵌着原斗篷的一角
facts.anchor: Part of your original cloak is inside

facts.fact: 结尾：你是我的平等者，我爱你
facts.anchor: You are my equal. I love you, Red Riding Hood
